findings.why: The core relay catalogue and the desktop UI render English 'Try again' as 'फिर कोशिश करें' (no 'से'; core relay.notifications.error.retry, ui x22), while the shipped mobile catalogue already uses 'फिर से कोशिश करें' for mobile.account_routing.retry and mobile.session_health.resume_refused. The common key matches the same-locale mobile precedent and is the more natural Hindi, so it is kept; the cross-product variance is recorded, not a defect. Verified by the same-locale vocabulary dump in audit.log.

The desktop UI renders Back as 'पीछे' (ui.onboarding.modal.action.back); mobile.notifications.back and core relay.* use 'वापस'. The mobile/core pair wins; a bare 'वापस' is acceptable as a text button on a header.
